# `aitbc trade refund`

Refund a trade on the settlement node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade refund [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--trade-id` | text | — | yes | Trade ID to refund |
| `--node-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--api-key` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC API key (default: config / $BLOCKCHAIN_RPC_API_KEY) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade refund --trade-id <trade_id>
```
